title: Immutable collaborative role policy pinned by one run
x-consumer-invariants: actors are sorted by actor_id and unique; each actor's roles are sorted; actor_id values match admitted ara.community-run/v1 actors
exactly one actor holds integration_pm and it equals the integration_pm field; it alone changes canonical logic/
every actor with publisher or continuity_writer has a non-null source_key; each source_key has exactly one continuity_writer, which writes only its own fork

publisher, verifier, argument_producer and authorized_reviewer authorize publication of contributions, verification attachments, argument_check attachments and review_attestation attachments respectively; integration_pm authorizes integration receipts and external_file_acknowledgment attachments
an argument producer's attestation of its own formalization never counts as authorized review
independence lists known shared factors; separate accounts never imply independent priors and the absence of a listed factor is not proof of independence
the policy is immutable within a run; a role change requires a new run configuration and a new policy_id
the plan-14 run-config roles (reader, contributor, fork-pm, integration-pm) stay unchanged; this policy is pinned beside that run configuration by policy_id
